name: Gabapentin enacarbil
summary: Gabapentin enacarbil, sold under the brand name Horizant, among others, is an anticonvulsant and analgesic drug of the gabapentinoid class, and a prodrug to gabapentin. It was designed for increased oral bioavailability over gabapentin, and human trials showed it to produce extended release of gabapentin with almost twice the overall bioavailability, especially when taken with a fatty meal.

pharmacology.text: Gabapentin enacarbil, sold under the brand name Horizant, among others, is an anticonvulsant and analgesic drug of the gabapentinoid class, and a prodrug to gabapentin.

uses.text: Gabapentin enacarbil, sold under the brand name Horizant, among others, is an anticonvulsant and analgesic drug of the gabapentinoid class, and a prodrug to gabapentin. Gabapentin enacarbil has passed human clinical trials for the treatment of restless legs syndrome, and initial results have shown it to be well tolerated and reasonably effective.

sideEffects.en: Common side effects are drowsiness and dizziness, which can affect driving. Like gabapentin, it can cause dependence, and stopping suddenly after regular use can bring withdrawal symptoms.
sideEffects.zh: 常見副作用為嗜睡與頭暈，可能影響駕駛。和加巴噴丁一樣，它可能造成依賴，長期使用後突然停藥可能出現戒斷症狀。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见副作用为嗜睡与头晕，可能影响驾驶。和加巴喷丁一样，它可能造成依赖，长期使用后突然停药可能出现戒断症状。

fact.en: Gabapentin itself is absorbed through a gut transporter that fills up easily. Gabapentin enacarbil was built to ride on a different, high capacity nutrient transporter, so more of it gets into the blood.
fact.zh: 加巴噴丁本身靠一種容易飽和的腸道轉運蛋白吸收。Gabapentin enacarbil 則被設計成搭乘另一種容量大的營養轉運蛋白，因此能有更多進入血液。
fact.zhHans: 加巴喷丁本身靠一种容易饱和的肠道转运蛋白吸收。Gabapentin enacarbil 则被设计成搭乘另一种容量大的营养转运蛋白，因此能有更多进入血液。
